invariants.description: stoichiometry: 3 Na out, 2 K in, 1 ATP -> ADP + Pi per cycle; the current is the net charge, j_Na + j_K = -i/F (exact)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(j_NaK_Na, 3*j_NaK_ATP, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_NaK_K, -2*j_NaK_ATP, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_NaK_ADP, -j_NaK_ATP, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_NaK_Pi, -j_NaK_ATP, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_NaK_Na + j_NaK_K, -i_NaK/F*1e-9, rtol=1e-12, atol=0)

invariants.description: second law: the pump runs forward only while the ATP free energy exceeds the ion work per cycle, i_NaK (A_ATP - W_ion) >= 0
